notes: DEV fix13 remains the oldest supported DEV updater contract.
DEV fix15 introduced an incompatible path fork by rejecting updater.html/updater.js.
While fix13/fix15/fix16/fix17 may still exist, DEV publication uses portable-replay-safe-v1 dev-delta packages over the common path subset.
fix17 makes updater.html/updater.js optional and replay-safe recovery compatible.
fix18 removes hardcoded DEV branding from popup.js so the same UI source renders DEV or RELEASE from the runtime channel.
fix19 synchronizes background, update-banner and runtime-status build identity to eliminate false TAB/Recargar states.
fix20 hands update execution from the toolbar popup to the service worker after folder authorization and adds a persistent VIENA progress overlay.
fix21 is an intentionally minimal test target for the real fix20 background updater; functional code is unchanged apart from coherent build identity.

fix22 authorizes extension-owned standalone tabs without authorizing web origins, performs folder picking in the standalone page, guards unlink during active updates, and recovers stale background-update state.
fix23 retires only obsolete recovery journal/request/lock state when the running semantic version is already newer than the pending recovery target.
fix24 moves DEV update-manifest reads out of the VIENA content script and uses the service worker state API, eliminating raw.githubusercontent.com CORS failures and invalidated-context polling.

fix25 keeps the hardened standalone-tab authorization path but presents a dedicated folder-link/relink screen, handles picker cancellation as a normal user action, and preserves the worker-safe updater required for the next RELEASE.
fix26 releases the root html width only in standalone folder mode so the dedicated setup card is centered in the full browser tab while preserving the normal 410px toolbar popup.
fix27 hardens RELEASE update identity compatibility plus installation-registry retry and 5-minute heartbeat.
fix28 promotes validated operator Assignments to the shared catalog and migrates equivalent local templates without data loss.
fix29 hardens installation-registry cold-start behavior and removes forced popup sync.
fix30 adds progressive 1/5/15-minute installation-registry backoff and resets it after a successful heartbeat.
fix31 restores the operator-facing RELEASE history through 1.3.29 and keeps developer-only implementation details out of that UI.

fix32 verifies linked-folder identity with read permission when possible, never renders unverified cached identity as current, hides the update-banner test action outside DEV, and treats stale registry identity as synchronizing.
fix33 requires a valid JSON {ok:true} registry response, rejects HTML/login/error responses as real failures, and keeps automatic retry active.

fix34 stabilizes fresh-install registry identity per operator+channel, includes a short Chrome runtime id in the reported build, and requires post-update registry confirmation after runtime verification.

fix35 suppresses Vuetify persistent-dialog backdrop bounce by activating the existing transition/animation lock on pointerdown outside the active dialog without cancelling the click or changing dialog transform.
fix36 distinguishes registry confirmation failures from actual update failures after post-reload runtime verification.

fix37 retires stale OS update notifications after remote revalidation, blocks DEV-only test messages in RELEASE at the service-worker boundary, validates RELEASE pointer/package coherence, and replaces ambiguous linked-folder pending-version wording with explicit verification-on-update UX.

fix38 adds a one-click Tareas Internas filter for the configured VIENA user: it idempotently ensures ASIGNADA, writes Asignado a through native input events, collapses filters, and refreshes the table without relying on dynamic Vuetify IDs.
fix39 turns the Tareas Internas assigned-user action into an idempotent toggle: a second click clears only Asignado a while keeping ASIGNADA selected, then refreshes the table.
fix40 initializes the Vuetify Asignado a autocomplete before programmatic writes, fixing the empty-field first-use case while preserving the fix39 toggle and ASIGNADA state.

fix41 follows VIENA's native filter commit path: after updating ASIGNADA/Asignado a it clicks the exact FILTRAR action instead of table refresh, so assignedTo is committed before the criteria request.

fix42 extends the persistent-dialog bounce protection to the open-ticket Iniciar Tarea flow: it arms a short transition/animation lock on pointerdown/click and immediately before the native Cambiar Estado action, without overriding dialog transforms.

fix43 adds an always-visible MIRA Listado de CMs block-selection action, groups selected street heights into consecutive 100-address ranges, previews the exact ticket text before copying, and keeps Copiar datos Edif aligned in the same action group when present.
fix44 reads Listado de CMs through jqGrid row data and broadens Dirección-cell detection so checkbox injection does not depend on one exact DOM path.
fix45 makes MIRA cuadras selection render immediately using DOM/title values with extended-address fallback and without per-row getRowData calls.
fix46 turns cuadras preview into an editable operational template, adds persistent selectable failure presets, and keeps manual text intact while presets are toggled.
fix47 formats CUADRAS as one range per line and recognizes any ESTADO DE FUENTE: prefix as the end of FALLA DETECTADA so newly selected presets stay below manual failure text and above source status.

fix48 adds a protected checkbox hitbox that suppresses native MIRA grid clicks in the selector area, makes quick-failure/admin panels collapsible, and adds explicit confirmation before restoring default templates.
fix49 moves default-template restore confirmation into a centered modal and adds smooth open/close transitions to the quick-failure and template-management panels.
fix50 makes the Completar Tarea menu and all personal-button menus mutually exclusive, so opening one always closes any other currently open completion menu.
fix51 updates the operator-facing RELEASE history through 1.3.35 without exposing internal implementation or publication details.
fix51 rebuilt from fix50 and validated by the DEV matrix before release promotion.
fix52 migrates installation registry heartbeats to the Apps Script v2.1 deployment and keeps all operator-facing functionality unchanged.
fix53 adds operator-visible RELEASE history entries for 1.3.36 and the current 1.3.37 before promotion.
fix54 sanitizes operator-facing release history and aligns the next release with the current published version state.
fix55 neutralizes Vuetify persistent-dialog outside-click bounce by disabling only the temporary v-dialog--animated animation; persistent behavior remains unchanged.
fix56 preserves the existing MOICA2 flow for simple nodes and uses Nodo CMTS only when VIENA's Nodo is concatenated, preventing invalid concatenated MOICA searches.
fix60 introduces the popup/full-view UX redesign, integrated button editor and icon personalization using only portable updater-safe paths.
